note: The Lumin <-> CMS seam. This file is mirrored byte-for-byte at ../cms/spec/fixtures/contracts/cms_contract.json. Both suites assert against their own copy, and against each other's when both repos are checked out side by side, so a change to one side fails the other's tests. Do not edit one copy alone. See ads/docs/cms-contract.md.

webhook.host: the Lumin tenant's own subdomain (tenancy resolves from it)
webhook.signature_format: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body>
webhook.signature_key: the Lumin Site#webhook_secret; the CMS Webhook row must be created carrying it
webhook.tenant_is: the CMS subdomain, which equals Lumin's Site#cms_key
webhook.url_is: absolute, canonical-aware, and identical to the address the sitemap publishes for the same record (PubliclyAddressable). Lumin joins Search Console rows to CMS records by it.
webhook.external_id_is: <kind>-<data.id>, e.g. page-12 — CMS ids are unique per type, not across types
